serverInfo.name: dart and flutter tooling
serverInfo.description: Connects Dart and Flutter apps and developer tools to AI agents.

result.instructions:
After completing Dart/Flutter code changes, always execute a hot reload or
hot restart.

Tools that interact with a running app require a connection to the Dart
Tooling Daemon (DTD) first. If you are not connected yet, proactively connect
using the `dtd` tool: first call it with
command `listDtdUris` to find DTD URIs, then call it with
command `connect` and the chosen `uri`. Only after connecting
will `listConnectedApps` return any apps.

Whenever attempting to investigate a package dependency, use the
`read_package_uris` and `rip_grep_packages` tools to
explore their files.

In addition to `package:` URIs, the server also supports `package-root:` URIs,
which resolve to the root of the package instead of the `lib/` directory. These
can be useful for exporing examples or tests when trying to learn how to use a
package.
